business_problem: unify ERP and business-system data globally so ABB could speed pricing, supply-chain, and distributor decisions without month-long data wrangling and costly Hadoop maintenance.
solution_summary: ABB uses Snowflake and Secure Data Sharing on Snowflake to unify ERP and business-system data globally so ABB could speed pricing, supply-chain, and distributor decisions without month-long data wrangling and costly Hadoop maintenance. Machine, product, erp, and operational data are centralized in Snowflake so supply-chain, pricing, and operations teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Secure Data Sharing lets the organization collaborate with partners or downstream consumers on live governed data without creating extra copies. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. ABB used Snowflake-driven supply-chain and pricing insight to save more than $200 million a year in inventory and support $900 million in revenue growth while unifying operations globally.
